claims.value: SILAC heavy (HEK293) / SILAC medium (786-O) / SILAC light (Caki-1)
claims.evidence: Fig. 1A: "HEK-293 (Heavy)", "786-O (Medium)", "Caki-1 (Light)". Methods: "HEK-293 and 786-O cell lines were grown in SILAC medium ... heavy = K8R10 ... medium = K4R6 ...; a normal DMEM medium (K0R0) was used for cells grown in light" (so Caki-1 = light); "Labels Arg6 and Lys4 for medium and Arg10 and Lys8 for heavy". mqpar multiplicity 3, labelMods ["", "Arg6;Lys4", "Arg10;Lys8"] (rule 14). Two deposit texts use other channel NAMES for the same isotope assignment: the PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol says "Arg6-Lys4 for light and Arg10-Lys8 for heavy", and the author sdrf.tsv writes 786-O "SILAC light" and Caki-1 "label free sample". Read as isotopes, both still put K4R6 on 786-O and K0R0 on Caki-1, which matches the paper; in a three-channel run K4R6 is the medium channel and K0R0 the light one, and an unlabelled channel of a SILAC mix is not a label-free sample. The previous curated SDRF (label free, 27 rows) contradicts mqpar multiplicity 3. No quantification table is deposited, so no ratio check (see limitations).
mqpar <fractions> 0..8 match file tags F0..F8; build numbers them 1..9 in the order F0..F8 per mix (fraction identifier must be a positive integer). Fig. 1A "High-pH fractionation".
Biological triplicates per labeled line (Methods, Fig. 1A legend "biological triplicates"); numbering restarts per factor group (cell line), replicate i = mqpar experiment i = file suffix -i.
Each mix/fraction was acquired once (one file per experiment x fraction in mqpar).
PRIDE organisms NEWT:9606; all three lines OX NCBI_TaxID=9606. NCBITaxon:9606 verified.

limitations: This file replaces the curated sdrf-annotated-datasets PXD045898 SDRF (byte-identical to PRIDE's PXD045898_community_annotated.sdrf.tsv), which annotated the 27 runs as 27 label-free samples of "Epithelial cell". mqpar multiplicity 3 with labelMods Arg6;Lys4 / Arg10;Lys8 and the paper's Fig. 1A show a triple-SILAC design: 9 sources x 27 runs = 81 rows.

PXD045898 and PXD039207 are duplicate depositions of the same 27 runs (see DUPLICATES.md). This SDRF is the PXD039207 SDRF with only assay name / comment[data file] changed to PXD045898's file names; every other cell is identical. A corpus must load only one of the two.

Identity rests on 27/27 exact name+size matches, an identical mqpar, and byte comparison of sampled 1 MiB blocks (F0-1 x2, F8-3 x1), not full-file checksums: PRIDE gives no checksum for either accession.

Rule 6 ratio check not possible: neither deposit contains MaxQuant txt output (only mqpar) and no RAW reader is installed. The channel map rests on Fig. 1A + Methods text, which agree. The PRIDE protocol and the author SDRF use different channel names (K4R6 called "light", K0R0 "label free") but the same isotope-to-cell-line assignment.

PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol says "All Cell lines were grown in SILAC medium"; the paper Methods say only HEK-293 and 786-O were, with light cells in normal DMEM. The paper is followed; culture medium DMEM is written for all three lines either way.
Which replicate of each line went into mix 1/2/3 is implied by the design (one mix per biological replicate, mqpar experiments 1st/2nd/3rd) but not stated explicitly.

characteristics[disease] for 786-O follows Cellosaurus (renal cell carcinoma, NCIt C9385) although the paper calls it "primary ccRCC"; HEK293 written as normal per the paper's "normal group" (Cellosaurus lists no disease; the line is adenovirus-transformed).
Caki-1: organism part kidney (tumour origin) with sampling site skin of body (Cellosaurus metastatic site); a reviewer may prefer organism part = skin of body.

cell type: PRIDE lists CL:0000066 "Epithelial cell" (PXD045898) / CL:0002518 "kidney epithelial cell" (PXD039207) without per-line support; HEK293's cell of origin is uncertain, so cell type stays not available. passage number not stated in any source. HEK293 age not numeric in Cellosaurus (Fetus) -> not available.

Inherited from the reviewed PXD039207 SDRF unchanged (do not diverge between twins): recommended columns characteristics[sample type] and characteristics[individual] are absent (minor findings of the PXD039207 review, not yet applied there either).
techsdrf not installed: instrument/analyzer/CID/scan range read from HTTP range reads of 5 RAW headers (all identical method), not every file.
Fraction identifiers 1-9 map to file tags F0-F8 (MaxQuant fractions 0-8).
